title: chatframe
summary: ChatFrameLaw owns the current Benilla frame anchor, background, border, authored controls, reveal/message/link seats, tabs and edit-box geometry; ChatMenuUiLaw owns popup placement. Typed composition, group utilities, channel protocol/notice behavior, scrolling and canonical XP lines remain intact. Chat now also applies the reference's client-side language barrier after NPC macro expansion: LanguageWords.dbc's 1,481 rows form 13 length-indexed pools; case-folded SStrHash chooses deterministic per-word substitutes and the skill/300 gate preserves graduated comprehension. Known language spells resolve through SkillLineAbility into authoritative PLAYER_SKILL_INFO fluency. No-player, GM and narration exemptions force Universal; foreign-language headers use the listener's faction default; the single rewritten buffer feeds both the chat line and speech bubble. LANG_ADDON is dropped even for non-ignored senders. Window geometry and the existing General/Combat Log product choice were not changed.

openItems.text: Text emotes do not exist - no /wave //dance/emote alias table and CMSG_TEXT_EMOTE is never sent (Benilla builds the full EMOTE<i>_CMD alias table from GlobalStrings)
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: EmoteCommandLaw builds the alias table and the chat submit path sends/receives CMSG/SMSG_TEXT_EMOTE.

openItems.text: Remaining utility slash commands: /invite //uninvite //promote group management are absent from ParseChatCommand. /sit, /sleep, /kneel, /stand, /lay, /roll and /played are implemented.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: all posture aliases and the /invite /inv /i, /uninvite /un /u /kick, and /promote /pr families are routed through exact existing group writers, including vanilla bare-command selected-player fallback and roster name-to-guid promotion.

openItems.text: No channel join/leave or numbered-channel sends, and SMSG_CHANNEL_NOTIFY is not consumed (channel RECEIVE formatting exists)
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: exact CMSG_JOIN_CHANNEL, CMSG_LEAVE_CHANNEL and CMSG_CHANNEL_LIST cstring writers and strict SMSG_CHANNEL_NOTIFY/LIST parsers are wired. ChatChannelLaw owns the ten stable server-confirmed slots, preserves holes on leave, decorates incoming and member lines, resolves /N and /c sends, and composes the full 1.12 notice table; guid-tail notices defer through name queries. /join aliases, /leave aliases and /chatlist aliases dispatch through the new writers. Focused ChatChannel plus ChatMenu, ChatTab and Chat regressions pass.

openItems.text: The Combat Log tab does not filter - DrawChatMessages ignores _chatSelectedTab, so both tabs show the same stream
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: ChatFrameLaw now owns the default General versus Combat Log group routing. DrawChatMessages filters through that law, and CombatXpGain posts Benilla's canonical named, rested-bonus, or unnamed line after deferred victim-name resolution. Focused ChatTab, Chat, and GroupSlash clinical checks pass.

openItems.text: Chat menu button is draw-only - the emote/channel popup menu it opens in the reference is unwired
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: ChatMenuUiLaw owns the exact 104x16 row pool, 12px tooltip borders, button-relative root and nested anchors, viewport clamping, hit testing, two-second timeout, root table and both Emote/Voice Emote tables. The draw path uses no ImGui window placement, opens the edit pipeline with reference prefixes, supports freeform /e and last-teller /r, and submits nested commands through the same posture/text-emote router. Focused ChatMenu plus ChatTab, Chat and EmoteAnimation regressions pass.

openItems.text: MSUI anchored ChatFrame1 ten pixels above the authored BOTTOMLEFT (32,85) seat, shortened its background to 434x120, invented a 30-pixel menu/scroll ladder, and inverted or shortened several FrameXML border anchors.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-23: ChatFrameLaw owns the exact frame origin, 434x129 background, four-button anchor chain, tab/edit seats and all eight border rectangles. The renderer consumes the law seats; focused Chat, focused ChatTab and the full interface clinical suite pass.

openItems.text: The Chat renderer still assembled reveal, message/link, control, tab, popup-card and edit-input coordinates directly even though the surface already had rule-owned base constants.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-23: ChatFrameLaw and ChatMenuUiLaw now return cohesive layout records/vectors for every remaining adapter calculation, with behavioral geometry checks and a no-new-Vector2 source fence. The General/Combat Log routing difference was not changed. Focused Chat and the full interface clinical suite pass.

openItems.text: Current Benilla intentionally does not construct ChatFrame2Tab until its complete combat-event pipeline exists, while MSUI exposes a functioning Combat Log tab with Money and XP routing. Decide whether desktop parity should hide that working MSUI surface or preserve it as an explicit MSUI behavior.

Current Benilla applies the build-5875 client-side language comprehension and LanguageWords substitution before chat, event and bubble consumers, while MSUI exposed the server's foreign-language plaintext unchanged.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-23: added the exact LanguageWords loader, SStrHash/token/length/case substitution kernel, spell-to-language-to-skill fluency chain, GM/no-player/narration gates, faction-default headers and shared chat/bubble rewritten text. The mounted build-5875 census and representative reference golden vectors plus focused/full suites pass.

openItems.text: Owner-run two-faction live acceptance: send Say/Yell and monster speech in Common, Orcish and a racial language at skill 0/partial/300; confirm deterministic word survival, punctuation collapse, case stamping, correct foreign header suppression for the faction tongue, identical garbled chat/bubble text, narration remaining plain, GM bypass and no readable LANG_ADDON payload.
